Trump threatens Iran at UN over nuclear deal

At a United Nations meeting, U.S. President Donald Trump said that after the United States' midterm elections a deal with Iran would be reached, and warned that if a peace agreement is not achieved Tehran will be destroyed, adding that the United States will not allow Iran to become a nuclear‑armed Islamic nation.
